articles.title: Market share of US-made cars hits record low in Canada
articles.mainIdea: Market share of US-made cars hits record low in Canada
articles.summary: Investing.com: Market share of US-made cars hits record low in Canada. Investing.com -- The share of US-manufactured passenger vehicles imported to Canada has fallen to a historic low of 36% during the first 10 months of 2025, according to Statistics Canada data. Related tickers mentioned: GM, HNDAF, TM.
